Experience Pakistani and Afghan Indian cuisine at Handi Restaurant Hanoi
Jun 2023 • Solo
The restaurant is quite comfortable and spacious, here I heard the staff tell them to serve Indian, Vietnamese, Pakistani, Afghan, Arabic dishes. The dishes on the list are quite diverse and look very attractive, the food is neatly arranged and looks quite good, the taste of the food seems new to me but in my opinion it is delicious, I find that the food here is mostly dry or fried and grilled dishes, in addition, the restaurant has mixed rice dishes which are also quite good.

Indian food is really delicious
Jun 2023 • Friends
Indian food is really great, it has a unique character compared to other cuisines in the world, Indian food seems to be very popular when combined with coriander or chili, the food is quite unique, I especially like the rice that is cooked and mixed with the food in an earthen pot and then they bring it out and we eat it directly. There are also many other dishes at the restaurant, you can come here and experience them.

Awesome Pakistani food
Oct 2019 • Solo
I’m a Brit, well travelled love all kinds of curry BUT, I have never had such delicious (and spicy) curry as I have at Handi! A good range of options and not the usual Anglo centric Western dishes. Some things I’ve never tried before. The mutton biryani is particularly good and so are the shish kebabs are something else. So glad I live near! The manager Santos is always very helpful and can tailor food to requirements. Very professional!
